problem: Fridge door bins carry heavy jars and bottles, and cold plastic gets brittle. The holder tabs, the small parts that hook the bin to the door, are what usually break first, and often the whole shelf cracks along a corner.
oem_situation: Originals are often sold as a bin-plus-holder set and can cost around $200. We price made-to-order bins from $65.
our_part: We print in PETG, which stays tough at fridge temperatures. We rebuild the broken bin or holder to your measurements. We do not make food-contact claims, so we suggest the bin for jars, bottles and packaged food rather than loose items. We need your model number, found on a sticker inside the fridge, and photos with a ruler.

how_to_order: Find the model number on the sticker inside the fridge, usually on the upper wall or a side wall.
Send photos on the request page, with a coin or ruler in the shot and the model number if you have it. We reply with a quote within 24 hours on business days.
Approve the quote and we print the part, usually in 5 to 10 business days after approval, then ship it to you.

faqs.q: Where is my fridge model number?
faqs.a: Usually on a sticker inside the fresh-food compartment, on a side wall or near the top. Photograph it and send it with the broken part.

faqs.q: Is a printed part as strong as the original?
faqs.a: We do not claim it matches the original. Printed layers are weakest where they pull apart, so we orient the print so the main load runs along them, and we tell you if a part is a poor candidate. Door bins carry jars and bottles, so tell us what you plan to store and we tell you whether the bin is a poor candidate for that load.

faqs.q: How do I measure or photograph the part?
faqs.a: Photograph the bin from above and from the side, and the door where it mounts, on a plain background with a coin or ruler beside it. Also send the fridge model number from the sticker inside the fresh-food compartment. If you still have a broken piece, photograph that too.
We make no food-contact claims. Use it for sealed or packaged items and do not put loose food directly against it.

faqs.q: Can you make just the small holder?
faqs.a: Yes. If only the holder is broken we quote just that, which costs less than a whole bin.
